question: Which three distinct third-page visits are most frequently observed immediately after two consecutive visits to the '/detail' page, and how many times does each third-page visit occur?
sql:
WITH ordered_visits AS (
    SELECT 
        session,
        stamp,
        path,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp) as rn
    FROM activity_log
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT 
        v1.session,
        v1.stamp,
        v1.path,
        v1.rn,
        v2.path as prev_path,
        v3.path as prev2_path
    FROM ordered_visits v1
    JOIN ordered_visits v2 ON v1.session = v2.session AND v1.rn = v2.rn + 1
    JOIN ordered_visits v3 ON v2.session = v3.session AND v2.rn = v3.rn + 1
    WHERE v2.path IN ('/detail', '/detail/')
      AND v3.path IN ('/detail', '/detail/')
)
SELECT DISTINCT path as third_page, COUNT(*) as freq
FROM with_prev
WHERE path NOT IN ('/detail', '/detail/')
GROUP BY path
ORDER BY freq DESC, path
LIMIT 3
